message.reasoning_content: No open description tasks. Add a targeted update refining the error-magnitude analysis for c1 (Skeptic's claim). I can reason about magnitudes: y_ref = p @ V where V' = V - 0.5*(p@V), so p@V' = p@V - 0.5*p@V... actually p@(p@V) ≠ p@V generally; with concentrated softmax (scale 1.5, scores spread), p@V' ≈ 0.5*p@V + second-order. FP16 error delta p ~ 2^-11 * p entries, ||delta y|| ≈ ||delta p @ V|| ~ 2^-11 * sqrt(sum p_i^2)*~||V||... Provide risk_map refinements for the experimenter. Record update.
